thread:
sara: ran a quick bring-up of 'compact-lite-v3' int8 on multilingual-holdout. dropping in the notes.
leo: sweet — hit me with the headline
sara: Headline: overall recall@1 drops ~1.6% absolute vs fp16; short-tail (<15 tokens) accounts for ~70% of the delta. clustering purity down; silhouette fell from 0.45 -> 0.38 at k=40.
mina: per-lang breakdown?
sara: en 0.875->0.857, fr 0.84->0.82, id 0.81->0.79, zh stable ~0.78. observed en+fr overlap in kmeans centroids for short queries.
leo: HNSW behavior?
sara: ef_search=64 gave recall@10 int8 0.939 vs fp16 0.944. ef_search=128 recovers to ~0.944 (cpu hit). tried rebuild with cosine_norm; small improvement but not enough.
mina: any cheap fallback heuristics we can use to avoid full fp16 decode?
sara: experimented with top2_ratio and max_cosine. top2_ratio < 0.58 triggers fallback -> fallback_rate 2.9% and recall@1 recovers to 0.868. centroid-variance threshold was more aggressive (4.7% fallback) and recovered to 0.872.
ops-bot: deploy-note: artifacts uploaded to S3: s3://evals/5001234567/int8_report.json
leo: rollout idea: canary 3% traffic (dedicated pool) for 48h, enable top2_ratio fallback, monitor recall@1/5, fallback_rate, cpu/delta. rollback if recall@1 drops >1.0% for >30m.
mina: I'll add silhouette(k=40), cluster_purity, and fallback_rate to the chart. set alert if fallback_rate > 5% or increases 3x baseline.
sara: tickets: ENG-1234 (canary automation, leo), ENG-1235 (dashboards, mina), ENG-1236 (quant-calibration per-channel, sara). I'll draft a short findings doc with parameters and cost delta.
leo: please include sample fail cases (I've uploaded 25 pairs) and a short script to reproduce the tiny cluster-merger example.
sara: reproduce command:
```
./scripts/run_embed_eval.sh --model compact-lite-v3 --quant int8 --dataset multilingual-holdout --k 40 --ef 64 --seed 7 --batch 64 --out /tmp/ce_int8.json
```
